text.p: Physicians Resource Group Inc said Friday it completed the acquisition of American Ophthalmic Inc for about $59 million in cash and stock.
American Ophthalmic was the eye-care division of EquiMed Inc.
Physicians Resources, a medical practice management firm, paid about $30.9 million in cash and about 1.323 million shares of its common stock valued at $28.1 million.
Physicians Resources said American Ophthalmic shareholders may receive $8.2 million more on or about April 6, 1997, if additional eye-care practices agreed to be purchased by Physicians Resources.
Physicians Resources said it retired about $44.5 million in American Ophthalmic debt and assumed about $13.7 million in debt.
